clearance.note: Every piece is measured against the ranger's own surfaces in the bind pose and at idle frame 15. Crossings with 'gated_refs' fail the build; the rest are reported because those meshes belong to slots this kit replaces (one piece per slot), and because a garment wrapped around a trousered limb necessarily dips into the hidden volume beside the limb. max_depth_mm is only meaningful within a few millimetres of a surface.

source: original procedural work authored by tools/prepare_makeshift_armor.py; no third-party model or texture
